units.source_text: 前太政大臣闻知此事，想起女儿云居雁做了世人的笑柄，不胜悲叹。

en.t: When the former Grand Minister heard of this, he thought of how his daughter Kumoi no Kari had become an object of public ridicule, and he was deeply grieved.

units.source_text: 便对她说：“你何不暂时观望一下再说呢？

en.t: So he said to her, "Why not wait and watch for a while before saying anything more?
He surely has some plan of his own.

units.source_text: 女子行事太性急，反而见得轻率。

en.t: When a woman acts too hastily, it only makes her seem rash.

units.source_text: 但也罢了，你已经说出，岂可无端自己打消而立刻回去呢？

en.t: Still, what is done is done; since you have already spoken, how could you simply take it back without reason and return at once?

units.source_text: 不久自会看出他的态度和意向。”

en.t: Before long, his attitude and intentions will become clear on their own."

units.source_text: 便派他的儿子藏人少将送一封信去给落叶公主。

en.t: He then sent his son, the Lesser Captain and Chamberlain, to deliver a letter to Princess Ochiba.
